name: @v3/shared
description: Clean-room shared code — pure library, no wrangler.jsonc (the cloudflare-os rule: a package is a worker iff it has one). Admission bar: code lives here only when two packages would otherwise hand-sync copies and disagreement would be a bug, OR a self-contained portable primitive worth sharing. Today: the egress secret-substitution door (both deployed workers) and git-wire (git-over-HTTPS smart-protocol codec + transport, the itx.repos layer's engine — a verbatim copy of apps/os's, one dep `pako`, no nodejs_compat).
